<module id="radix2_div">
	<!-- TODO: Document this module -->
	
	<description>A simple radix-2 divider to divide two 8-bit operands.</description>
	<ports>
		<input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
		<input id="rst">The reset signal to initialize or reset the module.</input>
		<input id="sign">Indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
		<input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">The 8-bit input operand for division.</input>
		<input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">The 8-bit input operand for division.</input>
		<input id="opn_valid">A 1-bit signal indicating that a valid operation request is present.</input>
		
		<output id="res_valid">A 1-bit output signal indicating the result is valid and ready.</output>
		<output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">The 16-bit output containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
	endports
	
	<parameter_description>
		<!-- List any named parameters here -->
		<!-- For example:
		<parameter id="EXAMPLE_PARAM">Description of parameter.</parameter>
		-->
	</parameter_description>
	
	<logic_description>
		<!-- Define any necessary internal signals or registers here -->
		reg [7:0] dividend_save;
		reg [7:0] divisor_save;
		reg [15:0] SR;
		reg [3:0] cnt;
		reg start_cnt;
		wire [7:0] diff;
		wire [7:0] diff_mux;
		wire cout;
		wire [7:0] remainder;
		wire [7:0] quotient;
		wire [15:0] result_temp;
		wire [7:0] divisor_negate;
		wire [7:0] divisor_abs;
		wire [7:0] dividend_abs;
		wire div_sign;
		wire res_valid;
		assign dividend_abs = (sign == 1 && dividend[7] == 1)? (~dividend + 1): dividend;
		assign divisor_abs = (sign == 1 && divisor[7] == 1)? (~divisor + 1): divisor;
		assign divisor_negate = ~divisor_abs + 1;
		assign div_sign = (sign == 1 && ((dividend[7] ^ divisor[7]) == 1))? 1 : 0;
		assign diff = SR[15:8] + divisor_negate;
		assign {cout,diff_mux} = (diff[7] == 1)? {1'b1,diff}: {1'b0,(~diff + 1)};
		assign remainder = (div_sign == 1)? (~SR[15:8]+1): SR[15:8];
		assign quotient = (div_sign == 1)? (~SR[7:0]+1): SR[7:0];
		assign result_temp = {remainder,quotient};
		assign res_valid = (cnt == 8 || start_cnt == 0);
		assign result = result_temp;
	endlogic_description
	
	<implementation>
		always @(posedge clk or posedge rst)begin
			if(rst)begin
				dividend_save <= 0;
				divisor_save <= 0;
			end else if(opn_valid & !res_valid)begin
				dividend_save <= dividend;
				divisor_save <= divisor;
			end
		end
		
		always@(posedge clk or posedge rst)begin
			if(rst)begin
				SR <= 0;
			end else if(cnt == 0)begin
				SR <= {8'h00,dividend_abs,1'b0}; //Shift left by 1
			end else begin
				SR <= {diff_mux[6:0],cout,SR[7:0]};
			end
		end
		
		always@(posedge clk or posedge rst)begin
			if(rst)begin
				cnt <= 0;
			end else if(!start_cnt)begin
				cnt <= 1;
			end else if(cnt == 8)begin
				cnt <= 0;
			end else begin
				cnt <= cnt + 1;
			end
		end
		
		always@(posedge clk or posedge rst)begin
			if(rst)begin
				start_cnt <= 0;
			end else if(opn_valid & !res_valid)begin
				start_cnt <= 1;
			end else if(cnt == 8)begin
				start_cnt</implementation></logic_description></ports></module>
